critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4850 lines. Invoice/billing/customer routes should be extracted to /app/backend/routers/ modules to reduce merge conflicts and improve testability.

delete_invoice registers BOTH DELETE /api/invoices/{id} and POST /api/invoices/{id}/delete on the same function with two @api decorators — works but is unusual; consider using two thin wrappers calling a shared helper for clarity, and add a comment explaining VPS blocks DELETE.

_invoice_totals treats the sum of item.amount as the IVA-inclusive total. If an admin enters an item with amount<0 (discount), _invoice_totals still divides by 1.21 which is fine, but there is no validation that final total > 0 — a factura with total ≤ 0 will still be created and emailed.

InvoiceItemBody.quantity is accepted but never used in totals (amount is treated as the line total already). Either enforce amount = unitPrice * quantity server-side, or hide quantity from the UI to avoid admin confusion.

update_invoice allows moving status pending→paid via API, but the UI 'Editar factura' dialog does not expose that — OK if intentional, but consider gating status changes to a dedicated endpoint (e.g. /invoices/{id}/mark-paid) to keep audit logs clearer.

send_card_link falls back to any_line.price > 0 or subscription.products[0].price if no ACTIVE lines are priced — this could send a Stripe link for a service the client is not currently paying (e.g. cancelled line). Consider requiring at least one ACTIVE line to avoid billing surprises.

_create_recurring_checkout always adds a 'Cuota de alta' line item if setupFee>0, even from send-card-link (where the customer already onboarded). Should probably suppress setup fee when purpose='card_setup'.
